entities.name: PMID:18459946
observations: Review describes adrenal suppression and Cushing syndrome arising from ritonavir–fluticasone interaction.

entities.name: Ritonavir-fluticasone excess
observations: Ritonavir inhibits CYP3A-mediated corticosteroid clearance, allowing inhaled fluticasone to cause systemic glucocorticoid excess and Cushingoid manifestations.
A safer clinical strategy is to avoid fluticasone with ritonavir and use an alternative inhaled corticosteroid such as beclomethasone when appropriate.
